playbook_name: JUCE VST Audio Plugin Development Playbook
target_domain: JUCE VST Audio Plugin Development with Sound Design Integration

metadata.code_style: Readability over terseness, inline C++ explanations

human.title: Creative Director & Sound Designer
responsibilities: Define WHAT the plugin does and HOW it should sound
Make ALL creative decisions (preset names, sound identity, aesthetics)
Approve or reject all creative choices
Test in DAW and provide feedback
human.ai_support: AI asks questions, NEVER proposes defaults for sound/naming/aesthetics

ai.title: Code Architect & Implementation Engine
responsibilities: Handle HOW to build what's defined

phases.description: Define exactly what you're building before writing any code. AI should be ASKING YOU questions, not proposing solutions.

steps.task: Define plugin type and signal flow
steps.instruction: Plugin type (synth/effect/analyzer/hybrid), signal flow, DSP chain order, parameter count. AI NEVER proposes a signal flow unprompted.
Reference plugins/hardware, genre context, character words, uniqueness. Record exact words as creative north star. Never paraphrase.
Lock: JUCE version, formats (VST3/AU/AAX/Standalone), target OS (ALL), target DAW, sample rates (44.1k-192kHz), buffer size range, CPU budget.
Define when hot signals are OK vs not. Audit existing gain staging before proposing changes.
Define creative direction for presets. User approves every name individually.
Structured doc: architecture, DSP with code, GUI with dimensions/colors, parameters, presets, build instructions, 'what not to do' section.
Check: placeholder values, contradictions, ambiguity, scope gaps, formula correctness. Verify formulas at boundary conditions (param=0, param=1, param=max).

phase_gate: Plugin type and signal flow defined
Sound identity documented in YOUR words (not paraphrased by AI)
Technical constraints locked (JUCE version, formats, ALL target OS, DAW)

phases.description: Configure development environment, install SDKs, set up build system.

steps.instruction: Use FetchContent in CMake for self-contained builds. JUCE 7.0.12+ recommended, JUCE 8.x for animation module.
VST3 SDK 3.8.x for latest features. Include in project via FetchContent.
VSCode/CLion recommended for CMake workflow. Debug and Release configurations.
Catch2 for unit tests. Integrate with CMake.
Create .gitignore for build artifacts. Initial commit with project structure.

phases.description: Create proof-of-concept implementation, validate DSP algorithms, plan architecture.

steps.instruction: Signal flow, module boundaries, data structures. Document all DSP modules.
Proof-of-concept for novel algorithms. Validate in isolation before integration.
Define classes, interfaces, ownership. Consider thread safety from day one.
Document unknowns, potential blockers, performance concerns.
Ordered task list with dependencies. Include test milestones.

phases.description: Create project structure, configure build system, set up comprehensive testing.

steps.instruction: Use FetchContent for dependencies. Configure Debug/Release builds. VST3/AU/Standalone targets.
Source/, Tests/, Resources/ directories. PluginProcessor.h/cpp, PluginEditor.h/cpp.
Catch2 test framework. Test DSP modules in isolation. Create test runner.
GitHub Actions or similar. Build on push, run tests, create artifacts.

phases.description: Implement audio processing algorithms, oscillators, filters, effects.

steps.instruction: Sine, saw, square, triangle. Band-limited variants. Wavetable support if needed.
Low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch. Biquad and SVF implementations.
ADSR with sample-accurate timing. Smooth parameter transitions.
LFOs with multiple waveforms. Sample-accurate modulation routing.
Check for allocations, locks, blocking operations in audio thread.

prevention_rules.lesson: Memory allocation in audio thread causes dropouts
Mutex locks in audio thread cause priority inversion
prevention_rules.prevention: Use lock-free queues or atomic operations for cross-thread communication

prevention_rules.lesson: SmoothedValue setParameterValue() called once per block instead of per-sample
prevention_rules.prevention: Always call setParameterValue() before getNextValue() in process loop

phases.description: Implement parameter management, preset system, state save/restore.

steps.instruction: AudioProcessorValueTreeState with all parameters. Attachments for GUI.
Define ranges, defaults, display names. Group related parameters.
Save/load presets as XML or JSON. Factory presets bundled with plugin.
DAW session save/load. Parameter recall. Automation recording.

phases.description: Integrate DSP modules with plugin architecture. Connect parameters to DSP.

steps.instruction: APVTS parameter listeners. Thread-safe parameter updates.
processBlock() implementation. Buffer management. Sample rate handling.
Note on/off, CC, pitch bend. MPE support if specified.
Variable buffer sizes. Sample rate changes. Graceful handling of edge cases.
steps.validation: No crashes with odd buffer sizes

phases.description: Design and implement user interface with custom LookAndFeel.

steps.instruction: Wireframe/mockup. Control placement. Visual hierarchy.
AudioProcessorEditor. Resizable if needed. DPI scaling.
Custom drawing for knobs, sliders, buttons. Consistent visual style.
Slider/Button/ComboBox attachments. Real-time updates.
VBlankAttachment for smooth animations. Performance-conscious.

phases.description: Cross-platform testing, DAW compatibility, performance validation.

steps.instruction: Windows, macOS, Linux. Test all target platforms.
Test in Cubase, Ableton, Logic, Reaper, Pro Tools (if AAX).
steps.validation: Plugin works in all target DAWs

steps.instruction: CPU usage, memory usage, latency. Stress test with high load.
VST3 validator, AU validator (auval), AAX validation.
External testers. Feedback collection. Bug tracking.

phases.description: Human perceptual testing in DAW. This is where audio bugs are caught.

steps.instruction: Test in REAPER or primary target DAW. Verify basic functionality.
Load each preset. Listen for artifacts, unexpected behavior.
Extreme parameter values. Check for clicks, distortion, silence.
Compare to reference sounds. Check creative goals met.
Detailed bug reports with reproduction steps.

phases.description: Code optimization, factory presets, final tuning.

steps.instruction: Use profiler to identify bottlenecks. Optimize critical paths.
Showcase plugin capabilities. Follow preset theme from spec.
Valgrind or similar. Fix all leaks.
Code style consistency. Documentation. Comments.

phases.description: Code signing, installers, documentation, marketing materials.

steps.instruction: Simple licensing or machine ID. Keep budget-friendly options.
Windows code signing. macOS notarization.
.pkg, .dmg for macOS. .exe installer for Windows.
User manual, parameter reference, troubleshooting guide.
Screenshots, demo videos, feature list, press release.

phases.description: Deploy to marketplaces, handle support, plan updates.

steps.instruction: Plugin Boutique, KVR, Gumroad, or direct sales.
Email, forum, documentation. Quick response time.
User reports, crash logs. Prioritize fixes.
Feature requests, compatibility updates, optimization.

sound_design.description: Comprehensive sound design knowledge for synthesizer development, focusing on psychedelic, ambient, pad, and creative techniques.

subtractive.description: Start with harmonically rich waveforms and use filters to remove frequencies, shaping the tone.

VCO.function: Generates source waveforms rich in harmonics

additive.description: Build sounds by combining individual sine waves at specific harmonic frequencies.
additive.signal_flow: Harmonic 1 + Harmonic 2 + ... + Harmonic N → Summing Mixer → Output

components.harmonic_editor: Draw/specify individual harmonics and their amplitudes
components.partial_control: Precise control over each frequency component
components.frames: Morph between different harmonic profiles (like wavetables)

implementation_considerations: Requires many oscillators (partials) for complex sounds
Each partial needs its own amplitude envelope
Inharmonic partials create bell-like and metallic timbres

fm_synthesis.description: Modulate the frequency of one oscillator (carrier) using another oscillator (modulator) to create complex timbres.

components.modulator: Oscillator that affects the carrier's frequency
components.algorithm: Routing arrangement of how operators interact
components.feedback: Operator feeding back into itself for harmonic complexity

algorithm_types.series: Modulators modulate other modulators in chain
algorithm_types.feedback: Self-modulation for chaotic, harmonically rich results

wavetable.description: Use collections of waveforms (wavetables) that can be morphed by changing position within the table.
wavetable.signal_flow: Wavetable [Frame 0..N] → Position Parameter → Oscillator → Filter → VCA → Output

components.wavetables: Collections of waveform frames (up to hundreds)
components.position_modulation: Creates movement/animation by sweeping through frames

modular.description: Separate, interchangeable modules connected via patch cables, giving complete control over signal flow.
modular.fundamental_signal_path: VCO → VCF → VCA (with LFOs and EGs as modulators)

key_concepts.cv: Control Voltage - continuous voltage signals for parameter control

modular.philosophy: Patch anything to anywhere - experimentation is encouraged

pad_sound_design.description: Techniques for creating lush, evolving pad sounds for ambient and psybient music.

psybient_sound_design.description: Psychedelic ambient sound design methods for psybient and psychedelic electronic music.
defining_characteristics: Ethereal Soundscapes: Lush pads, reverb-drenched vocals, nature sounds
Intricate Rhythms: Complex patterns at 90-120 BPM
Cultural Sampling: Indian classical motifs, shamanic chants, ethnic instruments
Emotional Resonance: Focus on introspection and transcendence
psychedelic_processing: Heavy granular synthesis on source material

filters: Rossum Morpheus (Z-plane filtering for 90s jungle pad sounds)

granular_synthesis.description: Sound design technique using tiny grains of audio (1-200ms) to create textures and atmospheres.

grain_parameters.spray_randomness: Variable for organic variation and diffused textures

workflow: Load source material into granular processor
Set grain size 50-100ms for pad sounds
Add LFO modulation to grain position
Apply reverb and delay for space

time_stretching_technique.method: Extreme time-stretching turns any sound into ambient drone pads
time_stretching_technique.result: Creates unique harmonic content and texture

spatial_audio.description: Creating depth and space for ambient and immersive audio.
creating_depth: Manage distance and perspective with reverb and EQ

distance_modeling.close: High-frequency presence, low reverb, focused stereo image
distance_modeling.distant: Reduced high frequencies, high reverb, wide stereo image
distance_modeling.movement: Automation of position and reverb over time

patch_methodology.description: Systematic approaches to synthesizer patch creation.

activities: Test in context with other instruments

syntorial_checklist.bright_vs_dark: Shape tone with waveform and filter
syntorial_checklist.tall_vs_short: Stack oscillators or use sub oscillators
syntorial_checklist.movement: Create motion through LFOs and modulation
syntorial_checklist.space: Add reverb, delay, and width controls

microsound.focus: Sound particles lasting less than 1/10th of a second, granular synthesis theory

composing_electronic_music.focus: Personal practice and aesthetic considerations for electronic composition

david_bessell.background: PhD in classical composition, member of analog synth group Node
david_bessell.resources: YouTube tutorials on advanced synthesis, Sound on Sound podcast

dsp_algorithms.description: DSP algorithms commonly used in VST plugin development with practical implementation guidance.
dsp_algorithms.note: This section will be populated by the DSP research agent

sawtooth.description: Bright, buzzing tone with all harmonics
sawtooth.band_limited: Use BLIT (Band-Limited Impulse Train) or polynomial approximation

square.description: Hollow, reedy tone with odd harmonics only

triangle.description: Soft, mellow tone with odd harmonics
triangle.aliasing_concern: Lower aliasing due to rapid harmonic rolloff

band_limited_oscillators.why_needed: Naive digital waveforms cause aliasing artifacts above Nyquist frequency

techniques.blit: Band-Limited Impulse Train - integrate to get band-limited waveforms
techniques.polyblep: Polynomial approximation of BLEP at waveform discontinuities

band_limited_oscillators.juce_dsp_oscillator: JUCE provides band-limited oscillators in the dsp module

wavetable_synthesis.description: Store pre-computed waveforms in tables and interpolate between them
implementation_steps: Interpolate between samples for pitch shifting

biquad_filter.description: Versatile IIR filter topology for many filter types
biquad_filter.coefficients: Calculated from cutoff, resonance, and sample rate

state_variable_filter.description: Simultaneous outputs for lowpass, highpass, bandpass, notch
state_variable_filter.implementation: Two integrators in a feedback loop

delay.description: Store audio in buffer and play back after specified time

algorithmic.description: Network of comb and allpass filters

chorus.description: Multiple delayed copies with modulated delay time
chorus.implementation: Delay line with LFO-modulated read position

flanger.description: Single delayed copy with modulated delay time and feedback
flanger.difference_from_chorus: Shorter delay times, more feedback, more pronounced effect

lfo.description: Low Frequency Oscillator for parameter modulation
lfo.implementation: Oscillator running at sub-audio rate, output scaled to target parameter range

adsr_envelope.description: Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release envelope generator

stages.decay: Time from peak to sustain level
stages.sustain: Level held while note is on
stages.release: Time from sustain to 0 after note-off

adsr_envelope.implementation: State machine with linear or exponential curves
adsr_envelope.sample_accurate: Process each sample, not just per buffer

sample_accurate_modulation.why_needed: Per-buffer modulation causes zipper noise on fast parameter changes
sample_accurate_modulation.solution: Smooth every sample using SmoothedValue or linear interpolation

juce_dsp_module.description: JUCE's built-in DSP module providing optimized audio processing classes

usage_pattern.prepare: Call prepare() with ProcessSpec (sampleRate, blockSize, numChannels)
usage_pattern.process: Call process() with AudioBlock in processBlock()
usage_pattern.reset: Call reset() when audio stops or parameter changes significantly

open_source_libraries.klang: C++ DSP library for embedded systems
open_source_libraries.daisySP: DSP library from Electro-Smith for Daisy platform

dark_theme_best_practices.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text (WCAG AA)

xfer_serum.design_approach: Hybrid - clean layout with detailed wavetable display
xfer_serum.control_hierarchy: Oscillators prominent, modulation matrix below, effects tabs
xfer_serum.color_scheme: Dark background, orange accent, blue for modulation

vital.color_scheme: Customizable themes, default is dark with accent colors

usage: Inherit from LookAndFeel_V4 or create custom LookAndFeel class
Override drawXXX() methods for custom control appearance
Set LookAndFeel on components with setLookAndFeel()
custom_components: Inherit from Component for custom controls

learnability.progressive_disclosure: Show basic controls first, advanced in tabs
learnability.defaults: Sensible defaults that produce good sound

marketing.description: Marketing and commercialization strategies for VST plugins targeting enthusiast-level developers.
marketing.note: This section will be populated by the marketing research agent

cons: Subscription model may reduce direct sales

free_strategies.implementation: Create tutorials showing your plugin in action
Feature-limited free version drives paid upgrades
Create sound packs that require your plugin

beta_testing.platforms: Test on Windows, macOS, multiple DAWs

launch_checklist: All format builds tested (VST3, AU, AAX, Standalone)
Listed on marketplaces (KVR, Plugin Boutique, etc.)
Announcement on social media and forums
Email to beta testers and early supporters

post_release.support: Quick response to bugs and questions
post_release.updates: Regular updates with fixes and minor features

licensing_basics.copyright: Your code and assets are automatically copyrighted
licensing_basics.trademark: Register plugin name if building brand

open_source_licensing.gpl: Copyleft - derivative works must be GPL
open_source_licensing.mit: Permissive - can use in commercial software
open_source_licensing.note: Check all library licenses before use in commercial plugin

cpp_documentation.description: Focused C++ documentation for Python/JavaScript developers transitioning to audio plugin development.

stack_vs_heap.stack: Automatic storage, fast, limited size (local variables)
stack_vs_heap.heap: Dynamic storage, slower, unlimited size (new/delete, smart pointers)
stack_vs_heap.recommendation: Prefer stack for small objects, use smart pointers for heap

smart_pointers.rule: Never use raw new/delete in plugin code

raii.principle: Acquire resources in constructor, release in destructor

rules: NO memory allocation (new, malloc, std::vector resizing)
NO system calls that may block
audio_thread.violation_symptoms: Audio dropouts, clicks, pops, DAW freeze

rules: Update GUI from message thread only

audio_basics.buffer_size: Number of samples processed per callback (variable)

block_processing.description: Process blocks of samples, not individual samples

interleaved_vs_planar.planar: LLLL... RRRR... (JUCE and most DAWs use this)

auto.caution: Don't overuse where type clarity helps

range_for.benefit: Cleaner, less error-prone than index loops

audio_processor.description: Base class for all plugin processors

smoothed_value.common_mistake: Calling setValue() once per block instead of per sample

component.description: Base class for all GUI elements

pattern: Override parameterChanged(const String& parameterID, float newValue)

debugging.breakpoint: Set breakpoints in processBlock to debug audio

audio_thread: Use atomic or lock-free structures for cross-thread communication
Never call new, malloc, or resize in processBlock
Avoid virtual function calls in inner loops
gui_thread: Only update GUI from message thread
general: Write self-documenting code with clear names
Comment the why, not the what

edge_cases.paywalled_sources: Prefer open-access alternatives. Note limitation when academic sources are paywalled.

specialized_hardware.aax_pro_tools: Requires Avid Developer Program membership ($100/year). Test with Pro Tools First (free) if budget constrained.
specialized_hardware.macos_signing: Apple Developer account ($99/year) required for notarization. Test unsigned builds locally.
specialized_hardware.hardware_copy_protection: iLok and similar require licensing. Consider software licensing for budget development.

open_source_equivalents: Analog filter emulation → Open-source SVF implementations
Proprietary reverb → Free algorithmic reverb algorithms
Patented DSP → Use expired patents or develop alternatives

sound_design_topics.ambient: Covered in pad_sound_design and granular_synthesis sections
sound_design_topics.creative: Covered in granular_synthesis and modular sections
